summary: Defines revision-scoped tree and diagram indexes, validates mapping freshness, builds stable representation identities, navigates tree structure, and resolves evidence bidirectionally.

sections.comment:
RepresentationContracts
|
+--> REVISION IDENTITY
|    `--> interface RepresentationRevision { artifactId; asciiSha256 }
|
+--> EVIDENCE LINKS
|    +--> interface EvidenceElementLink
|    `--> interface ResolvedEvidenceElement
|
+--> TREE INDEX
|    +--> interface TreeRepresentationNode
|    `--> interface TreeRepresentationIndex
|
+--> DIAGRAM INDEX
|    +--> interface DiagramRepresentationElement
|    `--> interface DiagramRepresentationIndex
|
+--> INDEX UNION
|    `--> type RepresentationIndex = tree | diagram
|
+--> SPATIAL RESOLVER
|    `--> interface SpatialEvidenceResolver
|         +--> resolveEvidence(...)
|         `--> resolveElement(...)
|
`--> BUILD REQUEST
     +--> interface RepresentationIndexSource
     `--> type RepresentationIndexRequest = source + selected kind

RevisionAndMappingGuards
|
+--> SCOPE IDENTITY
|    `--> function revisionScope(...)
|         `--> encode artifact id + ASCII hash
|
+--> NORMALIZE MAPPINGS
|    +--> function evidenceForMapping(...)
|    |    `--> persisted mapping -> evidence link
|    `--> function mappingsInVisualOrder(...)
|         `--> stable line/column/id sort
|
+--> ASSERT REVISION
|    +--> export function assertRepresentationRevision(...)
|    |    +--[artifact mismatch]--> stale artifact error
|    |    `--[hash mismatch]-----> stale ASCII error
|    `--> export function isRepresentationRevisionCurrent(...)
|         `--> artifact id + hash equality
|
`--> MAP GATE
     `--> function assertCurrentMap(...)
          +--[no map]--> accept
          `--[map]----> assertRepresentationRevision(...)

RepresentationIndexConstruction
|
+--> BUILD TREE
|    `--> export function buildTreeRepresentationIndex(...)
|         +--> assert map revision -> parseAsciiTree(...)
|         +--> pre-order nodes -> revision-scoped ancestry IDs
|         +--> overlapping mappings -> mapping IDs + evidence links
|         +--> unmapped semantic lines -> standalone loose roots
|         `--> stable order -> TreeRepresentationIndex
|
+--> BUILD DIAGRAM
|    `--> export function buildDiagramRepresentationIndex(...)
|         +--> assert map revision -> mappingsInVisualOrder(...)
|         +--> each mapping -> exact inclusive diagram element
|         +--[duplicate id]--> reject
|         `--> DiagramRepresentationIndex
|
`--> DISPATCH
     `--> export function buildRepresentationIndex(...)
          +--[tree]----> buildTreeRepresentationIndex(...)
          `--[diagram]-> buildDiagramRepresentationIndex(...)

TreeIndexNavigation
|
+--> LINEAGE
|    `--> export function treeRepresentationLineage(...)
|         +--> node -> parent links -> root
|         `--[unknown/cycle]--> [] or bounded ancestry
|
+--> SUBTREE
|    `--> export function treeRepresentationSubtree(...)
|         +--[unknown]--> []
|         `--> const visit = (...)
|              `--> depth-first child traversal -> stable pre-order
|
`--> SHARED ELEMENT VIEW
     `--> function elementsOf(...)
          `--> tree nodes | diagram elements

SpatialEvidenceResolution
|
+--> RESOLVER IMPLEMENTATION
|    `--> const spatialEvidenceResolver: SpatialEvidenceResolver
|         +--> resolveEvidence(...)
|         |    `--> scan element evidence -> matching element links
|         `--> resolveElement(...)
|              `--> element id -> evidence links or []
|
+--> PUBLIC FACADE
|    +--> export function resolveEvidenceElements(...)
|    |    `--> spatialEvidenceResolver.resolveEvidence(...)
|    `--> export function resolveElementEvidence(...)
|         `--> spatialEvidenceResolver.resolveElement(...)
|
`--> MAPPING LOOKUP
     `--> export function representationElementIdForMapping(...)
          +--[tree]----> find node containing mapping id
          `--[diagram]-> find element with exact mapping id
